evidence.title: Marko | Native Markdown viewer for Mac, iPad & iPhone

name: Marko
summary: Free native Markdown viewer for Mac, iPad and iPhone that renders tables, code, diagrams and math offline.
description: A free, native Markdown viewer for Mac, iPad and iPhone, universal on Apple Silicon and Intel. It renders GitHub Flavored Markdown with real typography, syntax-highlighted code, tables, Mermaid diagrams and math, works fully offline, reads documents aloud and is a viewer, not an editor.
